about: Kevin Rosales is a Guatemalan director based in Mexico City who goes looking for the real story inside every idea. He came to directing through graphic design, animation and editing, which gave him an eye for image and rhythm. That background shaped his documentary approach: casting real people, listening first and letting the story reveal itself.
His films are drawn to people on the edge of change: goodbyes, crossings and the in-between, where emotion surfaces gradually.

Kevin directed Cerveza Indio's Pay It Forward (Ogilvy), shortlisted at Cannes Lions, with a Bronze at El Ojo de Iberoamérica and a Merit at The One Show. His Embasa spot Line Guide (DDB) was also shortlisted at Cannes Lions and took Bronze at El Ojo.

On Cerveza Indio's The Mexican Dream (Bronze Lion in Film, 2026), he directed the B-unit for Nono Ayuso and co-directed one of its films, Miguel's Dream. On Tecate's Welcome Back, Paisano (Gold Lion, 2026), he directed the B-unit for Ariel Danziger.
He is now finishing his first narrative short film ahead of its festival run.
